label: D1 reward after a1 led rarely to S2 (rare-rewarded a1 trial)
explanation: Fires only at D1 and almost only when the reward input is 1 (98% of mass). Strongest activations (90% of the top quartile) are D1 steps right after the agent chose a1, reached S2 via a rare transition and was rewarded: the model-based switch-to-a2 case. Precision of this predicate is about 0.82 but it captures only ~61% of mass. Weaker activations come on other rewarded D1 steps after an a1 choice (a1 -> S1 common rewarded) and on rewarded D1 at window start; broadening to any rewarded D1 after a1 gets mass recall 0.84 at precision 0.27. Essentially never fires after an a2 choice (1% of mass), at GO/D2, or on unrewarded D1. Activity rises in mid-episode trials and is near zero in the last 10 trials. All variables are observed at D1 (previous trial outcome).
